earliest_activation: S104, only after S103 scoped Phase-1/Phase-2 PASS is committed on main and code hashes below are re-verified
target: zero-sumfree indexed sequence of length 43 in (Z/15)^3; if found, round-2 extension to length 44 is a separate preregistration
method: R1-ILS-1.0: softmin exact-new-coverage greedy growth + ruin(2..6 random deletions)-and-regrow iterated local search, accept if not shorter or with prob 0.02
search_domain: all finite indexed sequences over (Z/15)^3, repetition allowed, no structural restriction; engine only ever holds zero-sumfree sequences (oracle-legal pushes)
symmetry_reductions_proved_and_used: none used; CLM-0345(d) invariances recorded but no normalisation applied
heuristic_restrictions: move selection biased to low new subset-sum coverage (temperature 0.6); ruin size 2..6; this explores a heuristic neighbourhood only

budget.concurrency_note: CAM-0002 and CAM-0003 may run concurrently: 12 processes on 16 logical CPUs

checkpoint_format: JSONL: start record (params, param_hash), checkpoint every 500 iterations (best_len, cur_len, canonical best sequence + SHA-256, length histogram), CANDIDATE_QUARANTINE record if target reached, end record (status, iterations_done, best, both checker verdicts)
restart_procedure: runs are deterministic in (seed, iterations); a crashed worker is re-run from iteration 0 with the same seed and the crash recorded; partial logs kept, never merged as if complete
stopping_rule: per worker: iteration budget exhausted, walltime cap hit (logged WALLTIME_CAP_TRUNCATED, round counted incomplete for that worker), or target reached (stop, quarantine). Campaign round complete when all workers end.
on_hit: write candidates/<id>/sequence.json canonical sorted triples + SHA-256, rerun checker A and B standalone, mark CANDIDATE only; Lean 4 kernel proof + later-session cold recheck before any certification; no external disclosure without owner authorisation
result_semantics: budget exhaustion without hit is NOT evidence of nonexistence and NOT a negative result; reported quantities: attained maximum lengths, length histograms, iterations, elapsed time
code_sha256_note: SHA-256 of LF-normalised file bytes (identical to the git blob content); .gitattributes pins tools/zsf/*.py to eol=lf
